NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vidora uses the photo you choose to cut out your product and make its ad video. Photos stay on your iPhone.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Vidora saves the videos you create to your photo library.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Vidora uses speech recognition to turn the speech in your videos into captions. When on-device recognition is not available, audio may be processed by Apple.
NSCameraUsageDescription: Vidora uses the camera so you can photograph your product for its ad video.
